The States General of the Netherlands ( Dutch : Staten-Generaal [ˈstaːtə(ŋ)‿ɣenəˈraːl] ⓘ ) is the supreme bicameral legislature of the Netherlands consisting of the Senate ( Dutch : Eerste Kamer lit. 'First Chamber') and the House of Representatives ( Dutch : Tweede Kamer lit. 'Second Chamber'). Both chambers meet at the Binnenhof in The Hague .
